option.overstacked.reloadInfo: XML/JSON disk rules are automatically reloaded every time you save. Edit config/overstacked-rules.xml and config/overstacked-template-overrides.json for fine-tuning.
tooltip.overstacked.defaultMaxStackSize:
Maximum stack size for all items. Individual items can override this via XML/JSON rules.
Range: 1 to 1,000,000,000.
tooltip.overstacked.stackEnchantedBooks: Allow enchanted books to stack. Books with different enchantments will NOT merge into the same stack (enforced by vanilla component system).
tooltip.overstacked.stackEnderPearls: Allow ender pearls, snowballs, eggs, and ender eyes to stack above their vanilla limit.
tooltip.overstacked.stackBucketsPotions: Allow buckets, water/lava buckets, milk, and all potion types to stack above their vanilla limit.
tooltip.overstacked.stackTotems: Allow totems of undying to stack above 1.
tooltip.overstacked.stackToolsArmor:
Allow tools, weapons, and armor to stack above 1.
§cWARNING: Stacking damageable items may cause durability sync glitches on some servers!
